propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters degrade plan-review latency and completion-verification PASS rates materially; the limit blocks approximately 0.82% of current tickets while capturing the range with worse wall time and reliability.

Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false before any LLM call when description exceeds the configured maximum; light-bug review retains the P4 description block while downgrading other DET blocks.

Completion verification must check the authoritative ticket description against the same [verify] configuration setting and return a validated deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when the limit is exceeded.
The 8,000-character default maximum is configurable through typed [verify] configuration; exactly 8,000 characters is admitted and 8,001 characters is blocked.
